decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive Spirit creatures and protecting them with counter spells and evasion abilities. By building a board presence early and continuously applying pressure, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The combination of low-cost creatures with powerful anthems like Supreme Phantom and efficient card draw from Curious Obsession allows the deck to maintain momentum and threaten the opponent's life total. The inclusion of utility lands like Faceless Haven and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional versatility and threats to close out the game.

The deck focuses on assembling the "Lotus Field" combo, which involves untapping and sacrificing "Lotus Field" multiple times to generate a large amount of mana. The deck includes card selection, tutoring, and recursion spells to find and protect the combo pieces, as well as ways to cast powerful spells like "Omniscience" once the combo is assembled. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a massive mana advantage and overwhelming spells to win the game.

This deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant, while disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Power Word Kill. Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional threats to pressure the opponent. Misery's Shadow and Graveyard Trespasser help to control the opponent's resources. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to deal with opposing threats. The mana base supports the deck's aggressive plan with a mix of dual lands and utility lands.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a Rakdos color combination, utilizing powerful creatures such as Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure opponents quickly. It also includes graveyard interaction with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Misery's Shadow to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also applying pressure with powerful creatures and finishing off opponents with direct damage. The land base is optimized for consistent mana production and to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to utilize a fast-paced aggressive strategy centered around devotion to green. By quickly ramping up with cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck also features key cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Oath of Nissa to further support the green devotion theme. Additionally, powerful planeswalkers like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional utility and threats for the opponent to deal with.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up green mana devotion while putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures and ramp strategies. By utilizing cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to accelerate mana production, the deck aims to cast big threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll as early as possible. The deck also features versatile cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator for added utility and disruption. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful green creatures and mana advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Graveyard Trespasser, supported by powerful disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game, using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to maintain card advantage. The deck also includes a few removal spells like Dreadbore and Power Word Kill to deal with problematic threats. Overall, the deck aims to close out games quickly through a combination of efficient threats and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The deck aims to control the board with powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore, while also utilizing hand disruption with Thoughtseize. The creatures in the deck, such as Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, provide additional threats that can quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. The deck also includes a couple of utility lands like Den of the Bugbear to provide extra reach and flexibility in combat.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly build up devotion to green and overwhelm the opponent with powerful green creatures. By utilizing cards like Collected Company and Vivien, Arkbow Ranger, the deck aims to flood the board with creatures such as Steel Leaf Champion and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes cards like Aspect of Hydra to add additional power to its creatures and Boseiju, Who Endures for extra protection. With a focus on aggressive play and a strong devotion theme, this deck aims to overpower opponents in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using counterspells and removal to control the board while gradually card advantage and ultimately winning through powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also includes cards like Shark Typhoon for additional threats and card advantage. The manabase is built to support the control strategy with a mix of dual lands and utility lands. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating advantage and closing out the game with powerful finishers.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cheap spells and cantrips to quickly bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, utilizing cards like Pieces of the Puzzle and Treasure Cruise to draw into more spells. With efficient removal options like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse, combined with disruption like Spell Pierce and Brazen Borrower, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on while maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Otawara, Soaring City and Hall of Storm Giants provide additional versatility and threats to overwhelm the opponent.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly casting spells to fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenix, while also controlling the opponent with counter spells and removal. The deck utilizes cards like Ledger Shredder and Pieces of the Puzzle to enable the revival of Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It also includes card draw effects like Opt and Treasure Cruise to maintain hand advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and resource management, making it a versatile and dynamic strategy for Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and targeted removal to quickly overwhelm opponents and disrupt their game plan. The deck includes powerful creatures like Kroxa and Bonecrusher Giant, along with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to both red and black mana sources. By applying early pressure and disrupting opponent's strategies, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive Azorius spirits while maintaining tempo through disruptive spells. Utilizing cards like Shacklegeist, Supreme Phantom, and Curious Obsession to apply pressure and draw cards. Using counterspells like Spell Pierce and Lofty Denial to protect our creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Faceless Haven provides a backup win condition if needed. The goal is to establish a strong board presence early and close out the game quickly with a combination of evasive creatures and disruptive spells.

The key concept of this UW Control deck is to establish control over the game by countering threats, removing key permanents, drawing cards, and eventually winning with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck includes a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw options to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating incremental advantage. The win conditions include resolving powerful threats like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor, as well as using the planeswalker abilities of Teferi to close out the game. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent in a longer game.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the board through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to stall the game with cards like Absorb and Supreme Verdict, while generating incremental advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional value and synergizes well with the creature-heavy strategy. By effectively managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing green devotion to ramp up into powerful creatures and planeswalkers quickly. By using cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to generate mana, the deck can cast threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll ahead of schedule. Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional ways to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to establish board presence early and maintain pressure throughout the game by leveraging its devotion to green.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively build up green mana devotion through creatures and enchantments like Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, Wolfwillow Haven, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. By ramping up mana quickly, the deck can cast powerful creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns early in the game. Additionally, cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional value and flexibility to the aggressive playstyle. Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God and Boseiju, Who Endures offer powerful late-game options for additional control and resilience.

The main idea of this deck is to flood the board with green creatures and ramp up your mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. This enables you to play powerful creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Voracious Hydra early on, overwhelming your opponent with an aggressive strategy. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to further enhance your board presence and shut down opposing strategies. This deck focuses on using devotion to green to maximize your mana and creature output for a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly by utilizing green devotion creatures and enchantments, such as Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, Wolfwillow Haven, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. This allows for early plays of powerful cards like Storm the Festival and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset for additional control and power on the board. The inclusion of cards like Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional threats and versatility in the deck.

The main focus of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly build up green mana symbols on the battlefield while playing aggressive creature threats to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, along with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Oath of Nissa to ramp up mana, the deck aims to play powerful green creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Cavalier of Thorns. The strategy is to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game, leveraging green mana devotion for maximum efficiency.

Utilizing the Fires of Invention enchantment to cast powerful spells for free, this deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent. By including cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Kenrith, the Returned King, as well as efficient removal like Bonecrusher Giant and Skyclave Apparition, the deck can maintain board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy. With a balanced mana base and the ability to generate card advantage with Keruga, the Macrosage, this deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver its opponents in a game of resource management and strategic planning.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get Arclight Phoenix onto the battlefield by casting multiple spells in a turn. Cards like Opt, Consider, and Pieces of the Puzzle allow you to dig through your deck to find the necessary spells to trigger the Phoenix's ability. Cards like Ledger Shredder and Fiery Impulse help support the aggressive strategy by clearing the way for your creatures. Using counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal spells like Lightning Axe, you aim to disrupt your opponent's game plan and maintain control of the board while pushing through damage.

The main focus of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times. The deck includes cards that can cycle through the deck, discard cards for value, and counter opposing spells. By aggressively casting spells and utilizing graveyard recursion, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with the recurring threat of Arclight Phoenix while also controlling the board with removal spells and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Greasefang Parhelion combo as quickly as possible, supported by disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board state. The deck also includes various versatile threats and removal spells to deal with a variety of situations, while also incorporating some utility lands to support the overall game plan. Ultimately, the goal is to establish a dominant position on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and strategic plays.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and removal spells. It aims to quickly put pressure on the opponent's life total while using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser provide extra value and graveyard interaction, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can act as a finisher. The deck also includes lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear to support its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells. The key strategy is to combine the power of powerful creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill to control the board and push through damage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize while maintaining a steady stream of threats to pressure them into submission. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to gain value and control the board. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Unlucky Witness with Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, players can trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil's ping effect and Bloodtithe Harvester's lifelink. Claim the Firstborn allows for stealing opponents' creatures to sacrifice, while Fatal Push provides removal. The deck also includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary for additional value and card draw. The mana base includes various dual lands to ensure smooth color fixing.

This deck focuses on efficiently sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful abilities that deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Witch's Oven and Cauldron Familiar, along with Mayhem Devil, the deck aims to create a constant stream of damage while maintaining board presence. Claim the Firstborn and Kari Zev's Expertise provide additional ways to steal and sacrifice opponent's creatures for advantage. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Deadly Dispute to maintain control of the board while pressuring the opponent with aggressive threats.

The main idea behind this UW Control deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils, as well as efficient removal like Settle the Wreckage and Fateful Absence, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponents. With a mix of board wipes, counterspells, and card draw, the deck is designed to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and eventually closing out the game with a win condition like Shark Typhoon or The Wandering Emperor.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through removal spells and countering opponent's threats while setting up card advantage with draw spells. It aims to control the board with board wipes like Supreme Verdict and utilize powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to generate card advantage and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes a win condition in Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor, which can provide a threat while also generating value. The mana base includes lands that provide colored mana and utility lands like Field of Ruin for additional control options.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using low-cost creatures. By utilizing cards like Kytheon, Hero of Akros and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, alongside cards that pump up the team like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to respond. The deck also includes protection spells like Brave the Elements to keep the creatures safe and secure victory.
